card.name: Linking words before fishing and outdoor activities
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as for, to, when and 're that come just before an expected recreation or activity word, often fishing, snorkeling, dining or stargazing. The next word is usually an activity verb or audience noun.

modes.label: Fishing destinations
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'for' right before fish, cast or a fishing guide topic.
modes.example: FISHING FORECAST TAKES GUESS WORK OUT OF WHERE<< TO>> FISH Feb. 14

modes.label: Audience or purpose
modes.description: 'for' after perfect or guide, before a hobbyist group.
modes.example: user-friendly style that's perfect<< for>> astronomers at any level.

modes.label: Leisure activity lead-in
modes.description: A linking word before a leisure verb such as snorkeling, dine, relax or travel.
modes.example: bob up beside you when you<<'re>> snorkeling at Black Rock or Molok

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like bar and gr, which do not fit a clear theme, and away from words like drinking or skate.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that come right before a leisure activity, especially fishing.
